description: This file defines the DrupalImageUploadAdapter class, which implements an upload adapter for handling image uploads via XMLHttpRequest in a CKEditor5 plugin context. It manages request initialization, event listeners, and request sending.

classes.name: DrupalImageUploadAdapter
classes.description: A class implementing an upload adapter for uploading images in CKEditor5, handling XMLHttpRequest setup, event listeners, and request management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the adapter with a file loader and options.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Starts the upload process, returning a promise.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the ongoing upload if any.

methods.name: _initRequest
methods.description: Initializes the XMLHttpRequest object with the upload URL.

methods.name: _initListeners
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for the XMLHttpRequest to handle success, error, abort, and progress events.

methods.name: _sendRequest
methods.description: Prepares form data and sends the upload request via XMLHttpRequest.
